title: DosaTech Session Found — Evidence Preserved

fields.subject: URGENT: DosaTech Session Found — Evidence Preserved
fields.note:
The DosaTech ScreenBridge session on MBW-HMI-02 (10.72.10.22) has been isolated. The session log shows 1h12m of remote access from IP 10.200.144.122. The account was not tied to a valid user, and no Kessler Controls ticket was open for this window (Section 6.2). The session is preserved on MBW-JUMP-01 and will be forwarded to CISA via the WaterISAC cyber-incident reporting portal. Do not touch the HMI or PLC-02 until we have chain-of-custody. I’ve activated the SEC-4 evidence form for MBW-NVR-01, PACS logs, and session recordings. We must preserve everything.

Note: The attacker used a fake vendor name and an unauthorized path. This is not Kessler Controls.
fields.signature:
Priya Nandakumar
SCADA / IT Security Manager

original.subject: Audit Log: Unauthorized Remote Session on MBW-HMI-02
original.body:
Host: MBW-HMI-02 (10.72.10.22)

Session ID: SEC-4-2026-1022-082212

Source IP: 10.200.144.122

User: Unknown (no valid MFA token)

Session duration: 1h12m

Actions:
 • NAOH-FC-203 setpoint changed from 14 mg/L to 25 mg/L (08:05:03)
 • NAOH-FC-203 setpoint changed from 25 mg/L to 35 mg/L (08:12:47)
 • NAOH-FC-203 setpoint changed from 35 mg/L to 38 mg/L (08:22:11)
 • Audit log entry: 'Setpoint write to NAOH-FC-203: 38 mg/L' (08:22:12)

No Kessler Controls ticket was open for this window. No approval in the remote-access log.

Alert: Unauthorized remote access via DosaTech ScreenBridge detected. 

Link: https://mbw-jump-01.millbrook.gov/audit/SEC-4-2026-1022-082212

Evidence preserved on MBW-JUMP-01 for chain-of-custody.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the cyber-physical compromise. The security team must now follow SEC-4 and preserve evidence; they must not act on the physical intrusion claim from I-10b until the SCADA / IT Security Manager confirms the system has been compromised.
